properties.description: Friends (1994–2004) is an American ensemble sitcom created by Marta Kauffman and David Crane that follows six friends living in New York City as they juggle careers, romances, and family over a decade. The series stars Jennifer Aniston, Courteney Cox, Lisa Kudrow, Matt LeBlanc, Matthew Perry, and David Schwimmer and blends broad comedic setups with serialized emotional arcs. Much of the action is anchored in two neighboring apartments and a neighborhood coffee shop, and recurring themes include friendship as chosen family, romantic entanglements, and personal growth. The show’s tone is warm and humorous, balancing laugh-out-loud moments with heartfelt beats.

properties.description: Friends: The Reunion (2021) is a television reunion special directed by Ben Winston that brings together the principal cast — Jennifer Aniston, Courteney Cox, Lisa Kudrow, Matt LeBlanc, Matthew Perry, and David Schwimmer — for a documentary-style retrospective. The program blends interviews, archival clips, recreated set moments, and celebrity cameos to revisit the cultural impact and behind-the-scenes stories of the original sitcom. Across comedy and biographical beats it emphasizes themes of friendship, memory, and legacy, delivering a tone that is equal parts celebratory and wistful.

properties.description: Friends Like Her (2024) is a New Zealand drama starring Morgana O'Reilly, Tess Haubrich and Jarod Rawiri that unfolds after a surrogacy agreement collapses in a quake‑affected coastal town. The series blends psychological suspense with a character-driven exploration of friendship, motherhood and cultural belonging, as long-hidden secrets and loyalties begin to fracture. Shot against striking New Zealand scenery, the show emphasizes tense, emotionally charged performances and themes of grief, betrayal and community responsibility.

properties.description: Friends in Low Places (2024) is a documentary that follows a famous country music couple as they build a honky‑tonk in downtown Nashville. Starring Garth Brooks, Trisha Yearwood and Jenny Deathridge Bratt, the series documents design, construction, staffing and the culinary elements contributed by the couple, while emphasizing family, community involvement and musical legacy. The film blends intimate domestic moments with observational construction and performance sequences, producing a largely wholesome, reflective portrait rather than a conflict-driven narrative.

properties.description: Friends Like These: The Murder of Skylar Neese (2026) is a documentary that follows the investigation into the 2012 murder of West Virginia teen Skylar Neese. It examines how her closest friends became implicated in her death and how the case exposed betrayal within an intimate social circle. The story also considers the role of digital communication in shaping teen relationships and the aftermath of the crime.
